verdict.rationale: The eSignature REST API and the official Node client let an agent send a document and route it for signature programmatically ([docusign-docs-21], [docusign-docs-40]). Developers independently report building production envelope and signing integrations quickly ([docusign-comm-4], [docusign-comm-5]). An official MCP server is also documented and can trigger IAM workflow actions from Claude and Gemini CLI ([docusign-probe-3], [docusign-docs-39], [docusign-docs-47], [docusign-intdir-4]). Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server can create and send signature envelopes rather than only query agreements and trigger workflows, API- or MCP-accessible NDA drafting (AI clause drafting and dynamic templates are only shown in the CLM and Word UI), and hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end flow.
